challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map

products.producer: University of Arizona (A. McEwen, N. Emami); ISIS + SOCET Set 5.6
products.format: PDS3 IMAGE, attached label, RECORD_BYTES 27736, image at record 2
products.values: elevation, metres above the Mars 2000 areoid (Smith et al. 2001); SCALING_FACTOR 1.0, OFFSET 0.0
products.verified: file size matches label; min/max match VALID_MINIMUM/VALID_MAXIMUM; see validation-results.md

products.projection: identical to the DTM (same scale, offsets and bounds)

processing.analysis_grid: 3x3 block mean of DTM posts (2.974 x 3.029 m); block with any missing post = missing
processing.dx_correction: east-west spacing = map_scale * cos(18.49 deg) / cos(15 deg) = 0.9913 m per post
processing.slope: arctan(|grad z|), numpy.gradient central differences, degrees
processing.router: A* on 6 m grid (2x2 analysis cells); step cost = distance * (1 + (slope/10)^2); slope > 25 deg blocked; path simplified with RDP tolerance 4 m
processing.route_sampling: every 6 m, bilinear interpolation; segments of 60 m
processing.web_layers: ortho.jpg (2 m/px), hillshade.jpg, elevation.jpg, slope.png (3 m/px), elev3.bin (int16 cm) and slope3.bin (uint16 0.01 deg) on the 3 m analysis grid
